text: Steenbarger, on KDP: my method has no test for an event and I cannot see an earnings or news field, so I cannot confirm or refute minervini's event-driven read; that question belongs to the filter, not my lens. What I can see is a dip-and-reclaim shape: elder_5d [7, 10, 10, 5, 10], CORRECTION_REENTRY, mp_state FADING so R8 unmet on its letter; not red on the last bar, so buying is not forbidden (C3). That is a price-and-force pattern, not evidence of an event. I support the WATCH with h1_close_above:pivot_high; if the event read is confirmed, the exclusion governs and I stand aside.
